citation_with_page: Constructed track record: the Commission's rule 'mortality is high where relief is late, restricted or absent' applied to Orissa 1866; outcome per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orissa_famine_of_1866 (in-sample: the rule was drawn from these famines)
